entities.name: PMID:27496642
observations: 2016 study tested naringin against HIV-1 protease inhibitor-associated injury in cultured RIN-5F pancreatic β cells.

entities.name: Naringin
observations: Grapefruit-derived flavonoid tested as a protective treatment in cultured β cells exposed to HIV-1 protease inhibitors.

entities.name: HIV-1 protease inhibitors
observations: Nelfinavir, saquinavir and atazanavir reduced glucose-dependent insulin secretion and caused oxidative and apoptotic changes in cultured RIN-5F cells.

entities.name: RIN-5F
observations: Pancreatic β-cell line used in the 2016 naringin/protease inhibitor experiment.

entities.name: Naringin β-cell protection
observations: In cultured RIN-5F cells, naringin significantly reduced protease-inhibitor-associated lipid peroxidation, SOD activity and caspase-3/9 activities, and increased GSH and ATP; the abstract reports protection from oxidative damage and apoptosis. Inhibitor concentrations: nelfinavir and saquinavir 10 μM; atazanavir 20 μM; treatment 24 h. In vitro evidence only.
